Under pnpm's strict, non-hoisting structure, that folder only ever contains core's own direct dependencies (confirmed via a real debug trace against this exact class of failure in the Angular package's own stryker.conf.json: '@stryker-mutator/instrumenter' loaded fine this way, since it *is* one) — never a sibling devDependency of *this* package, like vitest-runner, which lives in a completely separate, isolated part of the pnpm store the glob has no way to see. Naming the plugin explicitly instead makes Stryker resolve it via normal Node module resolution (walking up from this config file's own directory), which correctly finds it.
